notes:
Original primary source unavailable: DOI landing page returned 403; OpenAlex no OA location; primary-paper search did not locate a free full original source. Secondary quotations in replication reports not used for original statistic fields. Replication extraction is independent. Requested replication test statistic is taken directly from p.4 report, replacing the author-table collapsed pairwise d/p. The reciprocal-RT ANOVA F(2,484)=0.39, p>.68 is a separate test and is not merged. Original values quoted in report remain secondary.
Source follow-up: Rendered target PDF page inspected; canonical TXT quoted verbatim. Requested d absent for this contrast; no conversion made. Canonical TXT OCR reads i(93), but rendered scanned PDF verifies t(93)=2.33, p=.02. Separate similarity-adjusted mixed-model test t(5418)=2.89, p<.01 not merged.
